questions.question_text: Evā santnu darshan thayu tyāre em jāṇavu je, 'Mane sākshātkār ______ darshan thayu.'
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Sā.10, Evā santnu darshan thayu tyāre em jāṇavu je, 'Mane sākshātkār Bhagwānnu darshan thayu.'

questions.question_text: Evā sant manushya chhe to paṇ ______ peṭhe sevā karvā yogya chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.An.26, Evā sant manushya chhe to paṇ Bhagwānnī peṭhe sevā karvā yogya chhe.

questions.question_text: Mārī ashṭ prakārnī je pratimā tathā je sant tene vishe hu ______ nivās karīne rahu chhu.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pa.68, Mārī ashṭ prakārnī je pratimā tathā je sant tene vishe hu akhand nivās karīne rahu chhu.

questions.question_text: Ā jīvne jyāre Bharatkhaṇḍne vishe manushya deh āve chhe tyāre Bhagwānnā avatār kā Bhagwānnā ______ e jarūr pṛuthvī upar vichartā hoy; tenī jo e jīvne oḷkhāṇ thāy to e jīv Bhagwānno bhakta thāy chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Va.19, Ā jīvne jyāre Bharatkhaṇḍne vishe manushya deh āve chhe tyāre Bhagwānnā avatār kā Bhagwānnā sādhū e jarūr pṛuthvī upar vichartā hoy; tenī jo e jīvne oḷkhāṇ thāy to e jīv Bhagwānno bhakta thāy chhe.

questions.question_text: ______ thakī koī bījī moṭī padvī nathī.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Ma.22, Sādhu thakī koī bījī moṭī padvī nathī.

questions.question_text: Ane e samarth to kevo je, enā netramā Bhagwān jonārā chhe te māṭe brahmānḍmā jeṭlā ______ chhe tenā netrane prakāsh karvāne samarth thāy chhe...
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pa.27, Ane e samarth to kevo je, enā netramā Bhagwān jonārā chhe te māṭe brahmānḍmā jeṭlā jīvprāṇī chhe tenā netrane prakāsh karvāne samarth thāy chhe...

questions.question_text: Evī niṣhṭhāvāḷo je sant chhe tenā pagnī rajne to ame paṇ māthe chaḍhāvīe chhīe, ane tene ______ thakā manmā bīe chhīe, ane enā darshanne paṇ ichchhīe chhīe...
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Ga.Pa.37, Evī niṣhṭhāvāḷo je sant chhe tenā pagnī rajne to ame paṇ māthe chaḍhāvīe chhīe, ane tene dukhvatā thakā manmā bīe chhīe, ane enā darshanne paṇ ichchhīe chhīe...

questions.question_text: Prakaṭ vāto prakaṭ vratamān re, Prakaṭ bhakta ______ re; Nathī udhārānī eke vāt re, Je je joīe te te sākshāt re.
questions.explanation: According to Bhaktichintamani - 164/6, Prakaṭ vāto prakaṭ vratamān re, Prakaṭ bhakta prakaṭ Bhagwān re; Nathī udhārānī eke vāt re, Je je joīe te te sākshāt re.

questions.question_text: Sant hu ne hu te vaḷī sant re, Em Shrīmukhe kahe ______ re; Sant māanjo mārī mūrti re, Temā pher nathī ek rati re.
questions.explanation: According to Purushottam Prakash - 41/9, Sant hu ne hu te vaḷī sant re, Em Shrīmukhe kahe Bhagwant re; Sant māanjo mārī mūrti re, Temā pher nathī ek rati re.

questions.question_text: Satpurushne viṣhe dṛuḍh prīti e ja ______ sādhan chhe ane satpurushno mahimā jāṇyānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe ane Parameshwarnu sākshāt darshan thavānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe.
questions.explanation: According to Vach.Va.11, Satpurushne viṣhe dṛuḍh prīti e ja ātmadarshannu sādhan chhe ane satpurushno mahimā jāṇyānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe ane Parameshwarnu sākshāt darshan thavānu paṇ e ja sādhan chhe.
